name: WNBA_R1A4D2_DEPLOYED_COORDINATE_TRAVEL_BUCKET_CUSTODY_V1

scientific_claim.target: Exact replay of the DEPLOYED travel feature semantics, not reconstruction of physical trip mileage.
scientific_claim.distance_rule: Use production WNBA_ARENAS coordinates keyed by historical away/home franchise display names and production Haversine R=3959 miles.

season_versioning_rule.franchise_keys: Derive the exact franchise display names appearing in each corrected season from the pinned outcome-blind schedule.
season_versioning_rule.coordinate_assignment: A season/franchise key is eligible only if that exact name exists in the frozen production WNBA_ARENAS map. Copy that frozen production coordinate into an explicit season-versioned mapping.
season_versioning_rule.expansion_guard: Never apply a current franchise coordinate to a season in which that franchise does not appear in the pinned schedule.
season_versioning_rule.missing_key: TRAVEL_UNAVAILABLE; never silently coerce missing coordinates to zero for research replay.

special_event_exclusion: Use the same 10 frozen gameIds from R1A.4C2; never calculate travel for those excluded special events inside the certified regular-season cohort.
